mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_order_list(user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, activity_name, goods_id, goods_name, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, payable_amount, status, out_trade_no, biz_id, payment_request_no, payment_request_time, pay_no, paid_amount, pay_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{teamId}, #{orderId}, #{activityId}, #{activityName}, #{goodsId}, #{goodsName}, #{source}, #{channel}, #{originalPrice}, #{deductionPrice}, #{payableAmount}, #{status}, #{outTradeNo}, #{bizId}, #{paymentRequestNo}, #{paymentRequestTime}, #{payNo}, #{paidAmount}, #{payTime}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, activity_name, goods_id, goods_name, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, payable_amount, status, out_trade_no, biz_id, payment_request_no, payment_request_time, pay_no, paid_amount, pay_time, create_time, update_time from group_buy_order_list where user_id = #{userId} and out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}

select id, user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, activity_name, goods_id, goods_name, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, payable_amount, status, out_trade_no, biz_id, payment_request_no, payment_request_time, pay_no, paid_amount, pay_time, create_time, update_time from group_buy_order_list where user_id = #{userId} and out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} for update

select id, user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, activity_name, goods_id, goods_name, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, payable_amount, status, out_trade_no, biz_id, payment_request_no, payment_request_time, pay_no, paid_amount, pay_time, create_time, update_time from group_buy_order_list where pay_no = #{payNo}
select out_trade_no from group_buy_order_list where team_id = #{teamId} and status = 1 order by id asc
mapper.update: update group_buy_order_list set payment_request_no = #{paymentRequestNo}, payment_request_time = #{paymentRequestTime}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and status = 0 and payment_request_no is null

update group_buy_order_list set status = 1, pay_no = #{payNo}, paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, pay_time = #{payTime}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and status = 0
